results.title: TN BJP Chief sparks row with uncivilised remarks against Vijay and his mother, TVK Ministers, leaders condemn, plaint filed with police
results.description: Chennai, Aug 15: BJP Tamil Nadu Chief Nainar Nagendran Saturday courted an unnecessary controversy by making uncivilised and disparaging remarks against Chief Minister Vijay and his mother, triggering strong condemnation from his Cabinet colleagues and alliance party leaders, who have demanded an unconditional apology from him, even as a TVK Woman functionary filed a complaint [...] The post TN BJP Chief sparks row with uncivilised remarks against Vijay and his mother, TVK Ministers, leaders condemn, plaint filed with police appeared first on News Today | First with the news .

results.description: Senior BJP leader Sudhir Mungantiwar, however, said Munde was an important national leader and that Mr Chavan’s claim did not befit his stature.
